/company/terms.label: Terms of use
/company/terms.title:
Terms of use.
For the Sary platform.
/company/terms.description: Terms governing Sary accounts, subscriptions and use of the platform.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of the terms
paragraphs: By creating an account or using Sary, the account holder agrees to these terms and the privacy policy and confirms that they have the legal capacity and authority to contract on behalf of the business.
The required consent is presented separately during registration, and the document version and date are recorded. If you do not agree, do not create an account or use the service.

sections.title: 2. The service and artificial intelligence
paragraphs: Sary is a platform for sales and customer service through WhatsApp. It may include automated replies, products, orders, bookings, campaigns, analytics and external integrations.

AI outputs are probabilistic and may be inaccurate. Merchants must review settings, sensitive information, offers and prices. AI outputs must not be the sole basis for legal, financial or health decisions.
Parts of the service depend on WhatsApp and AI, communication and payment providers. Their availability and policy changes may affect the service.

sections.title: 3. Accounts and security
paragraphs: Users must provide accurate information, protect their password and devices, and notify us of suspected unauthorised access.
An account may be suspended for a security risk, abuse or breach, taking into account applicable rights and the circumstances.
Administrative accounts and store ownership carry significant permissions. The owner is responsible for managing team members and transferring ownership before requesting account deletion.

sections.title: 4. Plans, prices and payment
paragraphs: The price, currency, billing period and limits displayed on the pricing page or checkout at the time of purchase govern the order. Outdated prices or marketing materials are not a binding offer.
The payment gateway processes card information. Taxes or statutory charges may apply and will be displayed before payment confirmation where possible.
Recurring charges are not made automatically unless the user enables recurring renewal and provides valid payment authorisation in a flow explaining the amount, frequency and cancellation.
The refund policy displayed at purchase and mandatory statutory rights apply. These terms do not limit any right that cannot lawfully be waived.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use and messaging
paragraphs: Unlawful or misleading content, impersonation, unauthorised access, unlawful data collection, spam and attempts to bypass rate limits or protections are prohibited.
Merchants must follow WhatsApp policies and electronic marketing requirements, obtain necessary permissions and provide a clear way to stop marketing messages.
Merchants are responsible for the content, offers, prices and consent associated with messages to their customers, and for the accuracy of product and service information supplied to the platform.

sections.title: 6. Customer data and privacy
paragraphs: The merchant determines the purposes of processing their customer data and ensures a lawful basis and appropriate notice. Sary processes the data to provide the service in accordance with the privacy policy.
Providers such as Green API, OpenAI, Tap and hosting services may be used as necessary to operate enabled integrations. Using them does not mean selling data.
The merchant must cooperate with Sary on data-subject requests and incidents and must not upload data they are not entitled to process.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Rights in the platform, software and trademarks remain with Sary or its licensors. Users receive a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the service during their subscription.
The merchant retains their content and data and grants Sary only the permission needed to process it and operate the service under these terms and the privacy policy.

sections.title: 8. Availability and support
paragraphs: We aim for reliable operation but do not guarantee an uninterrupted or error-free service. Maintenance or restrictions may be necessary to protect security or comply with requirements.
A special service or support level applies only if expressly included in a written order or agreement.

sections.title: 9. Liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damage caused by misuse, inaccurate merchant data or an external provider outage beyond reasonable control.

Nothing excludes a liability or right that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. Any permitted financial liability limit is determined under the agreement and fees paid for the service giving rise to the claim.

sections.title: 10. Cancellation and termination
paragraphs: Renewal or subscription cancellation is available under the account options and order terms. Its effect on the paid period and refunds follows the terms displayed at purchase and statutory rights.
Data subjects may request account deletion through the privacy centre. Limited encrypted financial records may be retained where necessary for accounting obligations or claims.

sections.title: 11. Law, changes and contact
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with jurisdiction determined by applicable legal rules.
We may update the terms when the service or law changes. We display the version and effective date and provide appropriate advance notice of material changes where required.
For enquiries, use the contact page. For data requests, use the privacy centre within your account.

/company/privacy.label: Privacy policy
/company/privacy.title:
Privacy policy.
How we handle your data.
/company/privacy.description: How Sary processes personal data, your rights and how to contact us.

sections.title: 1. Scope and roles
paragraphs: This policy explains how Sary processes personal data when you use the website, merchant dashboard and WhatsApp sales services.

The merchant determines the purposes of processing customer data and remains responsible for a lawful basis and appropriate notice. Sary processes that data to provide the service according to the merchant’s settings and its legal obligations.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
paragraphs: Account and store information: name, email address, phone number, business name, account settings and consent records.
Operational data: products, orders, bookings, campaigns, usage logs, support records and security events.
Conversation and customer data connected by the merchant, which may include phone numbers, message content and media needed for replies and analytics.

Subscription and payment data such as amount, currency, status and reference identifiers. Sary does not store the full card number; the payment gateway processes card information under its own systems.
Technical data such as network address and browser type. We may retain one-way cryptographic fingerprints to evidence consent and limit abuse.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Creating the account, providing the service, subscription and support, processing payments and fulfilling contractual obligations.
Protecting the platform, preventing fraud, improving reliability and measuring performance based on legitimate interests without conflicting with data subjects’ rights.
Meeting accounting and regulatory requirements and responding to lawful requests.
Sending direct marketing only with separate consent, which can be withdrawn at any time through the privacy centre.
Forms identify information required to create an account or provide a service. Not providing it may prevent the relevant part of the service.

sections.title: 4. Providers and transfers outside the Kingdom
paragraphs: We may use providers for WhatsApp, AI, payments, hosting, email and monitoring, including Green API, OpenAI and Tap depending on the integrations the merchant enables.

We share what is necessary for the purpose and restrict access contractually and technically. Some processing may take place outside the Kingdom under applicable requirements and safeguards for personal-data transfers.
We do not sell personal data or share customer conversations with independent advertisers for their own marketing.

sections.title: 5. Protection and security
paragraphs: We use TLS in transit, strong password hashing, access controls, merchant data separation, security logs and secret-management procedures.
Sensitive secrets and financial records retained for legal reasons use authenticated encryption. We do not claim that every field or backup is encrypted in the same way.
No technology guarantees that all risks are eliminated. We review controls and handle incidents according to their nature and applicable notification obligations.

sections.title: 6. Data-subject rights
paragraphs: Applicable rights include being informed, access, receiving a copy in a clear and commonly used format, correction, requesting destruction, withdrawing consent and objection where applicable.
Account holders can download account data, manage marketing consent or submit a deletion request through the privacy centre. Identity verification may be required.
We record requests and work on them within 30 days after receiving a complete request. When necessary, the period may be extended by another 30 days with notice and reasons.
Requests concerning a merchant’s customer data generally start with the merchant as controller. Sary cooperates in carrying out a verified request.

sections.title: 7. Deletion and retention
paragraphs: We retain data for as long as necessary to operate the account or fulfil the purpose of collection, then delete or de-identify it under the retention schedule.

Once account deletion is confirmed, access, automated replies and the WhatsApp connection are stopped, and account and store data removal is scheduled. If automated processing fails, it may move to human review instead of incomplete deletion.
A minimum set of invoice and payment records may be retained in encrypted form for accounting obligations or legal claims and destroyed when the reason for retention ends.
Removal from backups may take until the scheduled replacement cycle. Backup use is restricted to recovery and security.

sections.title: 8. Direct marketing and cookies
paragraphs: Marketing-message consent is separate and optional. Withdrawing it does not affect essential service messages such as security and billing notices.
We use essential cookies for sessions, protection and preferences. If non-essential analytics are enabled, their options are presented as required by law.

sections.title: 9. Complaints and contact
paragraphs: Account requests can be submitted through the privacy centre. Use the contact page for enquiries, objections or complaints.
If a complaint is not resolved, the data subject may contact the competent data-protection authority in Saudi Arabia through its available official channels.

sections.title: 10. Updates
paragraphs: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the service or legal requirements. We display the version and effective date and request fresh consent when a consent-based purpose changes materially.
